race.comment: NUMBER ONE RANGER (10) cops a second-row draw but looks close to a win. His latest third behind Our Ultimate Milly came in NR 51 to 57 grade at Albion Park and he now drops to NR 47 to 52, while the start prior he was beaten just under two metres behind Bettor Be Bodhi and had LONGSHOT well covered. LONGSHOT (9) is the main danger on track-and-distance credentials, with two wins and two placings from seven at Albion Park over the trip and a narrow second two back, though he has to offset a plain latest sixth and the draw reversal against WARRAWEE FLYER. MYTHICAL DRAGON (1) gets the best set-up of the key chances from gate one after being well beaten in his past two, so the rebound case rests on his Albion Park record and cleaner run. WARRAWEE FLYER (2) has recent form that needs lifting, but Nathan Dawson has won four from twelve aboard her and her 2138m record keeps her in the discussion.
